subject: literacy
concept: Unit review and mastery check for P1 Fluency, and full P1 Literacy year-end review
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Mixed set of CVCe, vowel team, and expression-based questions spanning nodes 01-07
exercise.abstract: Full passage read-aloud combining fluency, self-correction, and comprehension, spanning all P1 literacy skills

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed question types, plus a passing fluency read-aloud
misconception_flags: any single-node misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
next_node_on_fail: LITERACY.P1.FLUENCY.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
